subject: Final readout scheduling and decision — StagingHealth POC
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@staginghealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + draft POC plan (post-call)

Hi Alex — great speaking earlier. Quick written recap and a concrete next step so we’re all aligned.

Call summary (3 key points)
- Primary objective: validate 4 key workflows where model assists intake triage and chart summarization (reduces TAT for triage by 30% target).
- Data: you’ll provide de-identified sample volume (10k notes) and 2 weeks of traffic pattern logs for sequence-length profile.
- Success criteria: 1) <200ms p50 generation for typical prompts, 2) accuracy/utility score >= 0.82 on the annotated checklist, 3) no PII leakage in synthetic tests.

Proposed POC plan (draft)
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week build + 2-week evaluation).
- Redwood deliverables: hosted dedicated trial capacity, 1 integration sprint (ingest + transform), evaluation harness + dashboard.
- StagingHealth deliverables: de-identified sample data, security point-of-contact, exec slot for final readout.
- Owners: Rishi (sales/PM), Monica (solutions eng), Marissa (customer success).

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm the two success metrics above or send any edits by EOD Friday (Apr 16).
2) Share contact for security/compliance and preferred region for trial (us-east/us-west).
3) Confirm potential exec readout window week of May 10 — do you already have a preferred day?

Attached: staginghealth-poc-draft.pdf (plan) and eval-metrics-template.xlsx (workbook we’ll use to capture scores).

If this looks good I’ll lock timelines and spin up the initial environment.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@staginghealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + draft POC plan (post-call)

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick items: 

1) Success criteria: the three you listed look good; I’ll circulate to our clinical lead for the annotated checklist and confirm the 0.82 threshold.
2) Security/compliance: please send any vendor questionnaire to security@staginghealth.com — our security lead (Jordan Lee) is looped in there. We do require SOC2 attestation and a brief architecture diagram.
3) Region: us-east preferred.
4) Exec readout: May 12 (Wed) afternoon looks best on our side for a 30–45 min slot; tentatively hold that.

Procurement note: we’ll need a short SOW + pricing once the POC is greenlit. Procurement (procurement@staginghealth.com) is CC’d on this reply so they see timing constraints.

One more ask — can Redwood provide a short privacy/data-flow blurb I can share with our privacy counsel?

Best,
Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Clinical Platforms, StagingHealth
alex.kim@staginghealth.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + draft POC plan (post-call)

Rishi / Marissa — quick internal note after Alex’s reply.

Operational checklist for POC (items we should own)
- Environment: allocate 1 dedicated GPU node in us-east, enable KV cache logging. (Owner: Monica)
- Integration: connector mapping for notes -> normalized prompt templates (Owner: Solutions). Need sample file format by Apr 20.
- Eval harness: we’ll seed the eval-metrics-template.xlsx with 3 baseline prompts and run an initial 200-sample pass. (Owner: Marissa)
- Security artifacts: I’ll kick off SOC2/architecture summary and hand to Rishi for sharing.

Timeline (internal)
- Apr 20: receive sample data + security contact
- Apr 22–29: integration + staging validation
- Apr 30–May 6: blind evaluation run
- May 12: final readout (customer exec) and go/no-go decision

Notes: If Alex confirms May 12 we should reserve a Redwood exec slot (Monica, Marissa, and a Solutions eng). Also prepare the short pricing SOW draft so Procurement has something to review immediately after a go decision.

On quoting Alex’s security ask — I have a one-page privacy blurb I can send; Rishi, do you want me to attach it to the next outbound?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Sr Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@staginghealth.com>, Jordan Lee <security@staginghealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@staginghealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Schedule: Final readout & go/no-go decision (May 12)

Alex / Jordan / Procurement — thanks for the quick replies and for looping procurement & security. Per our earlier notes we’re locking the final readout for Wednesday, May 12 at 16:00 ET (13:00 PT). Please confirm if that works for your execs; we can shift earlier that day if needed.

Agenda (30–45 min)
- 5 min: recap of objectives and trial setup
- 10 min: evaluation results and the Redwood dashboard walk-through (Monica)
- 10 min: risks/mitigations + security findings (Monica / Jordan)
- 10 min: decision and next steps (contract/SOW handoff to Procurement)

Decision ask: Please confirm who on your side will have final sign-off (name & title). That will help us ensure Redwood brings the right stakeholders (sales lead + legal + solutions lead).

Attachments: final-eval-checklist.xlsx (this is the version we’ll use in the readout).

Related links: calendar (https://redwood-console.app/meet/zoom-abc123) and draft SOW in HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8572). I’ll open a DocuSign room for contract terms after the readout if we get a go.

Next steps (I’ll action after you confirm):
- Monica: prepare the dashboard export and the privacy blurb for Jordan.
- Marissa: prep the SOW/pricing draft and redline template for Procurement.
- Me: reserve exec slot in my calendar and send calendar invite once Alex confirms attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to the readout.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
